fields.Name: R1 -> S6.6
fields.Description: Gate G2.17 (phase 2, dataset R1, criterion S6.6): on R1 one run declares split-conformal prediction intervals at 80% and 90% for a fully grown random-forest finalist; their observed coverage of the 1,500 held-out rows lies in 0.769-0.831 and 0.877-0.923 (nominal +/- 3 binomial standard errors), 2 of 2 levels. It fails when prediction intervals are sized from the refit finalist's training residuals instead of the out-of-fold rows (80% coverage falls to 0.361).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 80% and 90% split-conformal intervals of a random-forest finalist on R1 cover 0.769-0.831 and 0.877-0.923 of the 1,500 held-out rows (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
